scientific_limitations: Terminal-time one-dimensional nearest-neighbor one-attempt antagonistic AB adsorption only. The two-vacancy event is rare under extreme proposal bias; the attenuation bound is sharp only in the limiting sense. The adjacent-uncolored-vacancy intensity is included for normalization and is implied by earlier published cluster intensities; it is not claimed as independently novel. Full conditional half-line separation and bias attenuation are the assessed results.
title: Double-vacancy shielding and sharp species-bias attenuation in antagonistic adsorption
